What is a swim up suite, anyway?

It can be a different thing depending on the resort — and the details matter more than the photo.

Sometimes it's a shared channel: you step out into water everyone on your floor shares.
Sometimes it's your own private pool on the terrace — Catalonia's Swim Up suites are that kind.
Sometimes it's a lane of your own — Atelier's Swim Out suites step into a heated semi-private lane, which is not the same as their plunge-pool suites.
And sometimes the pool leads straight to the swim-up bar — El Dorado Seaside Suites' Premium Swim Up suites are that kind.

Want the kids to enjoy the swim-out room? Every resort has different rules — at Hyatt Ziva Cancun it's 13+, at Barceló Maya's Caribe and Beach it's 8+. And check the section and whether the water is heated for your dates.

Tell me who's traveling and what kind of trip you want — I'll point you to the rooms that actually fit.

Read the full guide: https://www.irenestravel.com/what-is-a-swim-up-suite.html

🌍 Africa Friday

If Africa is on your wish list, add Victoria Falls.

Every Victoria Falls itinerary we plan, we recommend one experience above all — a helicopter flight over the Falls, the Flight of Angels:

🚁 The full Falls, all at once — at 1.7 km wide, no ground viewpoint shows the whole curtain at once. From the air, you see it in a single frame.

🚁 The gorge and the river — fly over the zig-zagging Batoka Gorge and up the Zambezi River, a view impossible from the ground.

🚁 The Smoke That Thunders — Mosi-oa-Tunya, the local name, makes sense from above: spray rising hundreds of meters, rainbows in the mist.

🚁 Two ways to fly — 12–13 minutes for the Falls and gorges, or 25 minutes along the Zambezi and over Zambezi National Park.

All ages, weather permitting; best light early morning or late afternoon.

Put the Falls on your list, and see them from above — the view you'll never forget.

Footage courtesy of Wishing for Africa Safaris & Getaways , our local tour operator in Victoria Falls.

🐧 AFRICA FRIDAY with Irene's Travel 🐧
Wishing for Africa Safaris & Getaways sent me this video, and I can't stop watching it.
This is a penguin release at Stony Point in Betty's Bay, South Africa.
Those boxes hold African penguins rescued and rehabilitated by SANCCOB — birds that arrived sick, injured, abandoned as chicks, or covered in oil. After weeks or months of care, this is the moment they go home.
Stony Point is an easy stop on a Cape Town trip — there's a boardwalk where you can watch the colony up close. And if you're there Nov 7, the reserve hosts Penguin Palooza with CapeNature and SANCCOB, celebrating exactly this work.
My local partners in South Africa work with SANCCOB — and if you're passionate about penguins, a visit to their seabird centre is one of the most moving stops we can build into your Cape Town itinerary as an option.
The African penguin is now Critically Endangered. Fewer than 8,750 breeding pairs are left on the whole South African coast, and Stony Point — one of only two mainland colonies — counted just 406 breeding pairs this year. Scientists warn the species could vanish from the wild by 2035 if the decline continues. Every bird in those boxes is one the ocean almost lost.
Watch how they do it: out of the boxes, a pause to get their bearings… then all together, straight into the surf. (There's always one who needs an extra minute. I respect it.)
And how do penguins make a decision? They flipper a coin. 🐧

“We’re going to Mexico to relax.”

Also your family: What are we doing after breakfast? 😂

Hotel Xcaret México is one to consider when your people need more than a pool. Its All-Fun Inclusive concept includes:

🌴 Access to Xcaret, Xel-Há, Xplor, Xplor Fuego, Xenses, Xoximilco and the Xenotes cenote tour
🚌 Transportation to and from the parks
🚣 Kayaking and paddleboarding at the hotel
⛴️ Ferry tickets to Isla Mujeres and Cozumel, plus transportation to the terminals
⛵ An Isla Mujeres catamaran outing with snorkeling
🎭 The México Espectacular evening show at Xcaret park

So yes, you can swim in underground rivers, zip-line through the jungle and explore cenotes—with plenty of adventures already included in your vacation budget.

Now we just need to schedule your nap. 😎
